This plot is my main piece of land, so I want to get a good harvest from it. I will buy some subsidized fertilizer from the voucher program and use manure from my cattle, because the soil here in Tabora gets tired after the long dry season. For seed, I will plant the improved variety I got from the extension agent last year, and I will spray a little pesticide to protect the leaves since this crop brings money for school fees. We will work this plot with our hoes as a family, but I may hire a few days of help when it is time to weed quickly before the rains stop.
